audit.why: Kayle is melee with no dash and no ranged tool until her passive ranks up, so Poppy owns Level 1; from 6 onward Divine Judgment and ranged form flip it.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Poppy; rows 5, 6 and 7 to Kayle, in matched full/content pairs, ratings rescaled. Matches the audited kayle__poppy mirror exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1].why tells the player to hold W to delete Kayle's dash. Kayle has no dash in her kit at all. The page also carries no cooldown numbers anywhere — the packet lists sequencingCues 0.
audit.why: Kayle's mobility is move speed from Celestial Blessing and her passive, neither of which Steadfast Presence can stop. Meanwhile the real levers are concrete: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s, Starfire Spellblade is an 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s auto-attack reset that scales off missing health, Celestial Blessing heals on a flat 15s, and Heroic Charge is back every 14/13/12/11/10s.
audit.corrected: Dash line replaced with the no-dash reality plus Heroic Charge's 14s cooldown; Divine Judgment's 160s rank-1 cooldown named as the bait window; Starfire Spellblade's wind-up named as the burst tell rather than the cast; Celestial Blessing's 15s heal named in the trade rule.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Kayle's Divine Judgment is down.
edits.after: Kayle has no dash and no ranged tool yet — E her into your wall on sight; Heroic Charge is back every 14s at rank 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Divine Judgment's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her Starfire Spellblade auto reset, up every 8s, is the burst tell — step out on the wind-up, not the cast, and force short trades.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kayle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is a 160s cooldown at rank 1 — the longest it will ever be. Bait it, then all-in; once it is back she pulls ahead.

notes: Kayle is referred to as 'he/his' throughout the full layer (enemyWin, ahead, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, report[8], report[9], report[12]) — I fixed only the strings I was already editing; the rest needs a champion-level pronoun pass. Open question I deliberately did not answer on the page: whether Divine Judgment's invulnerability blanks the damage of your wall-stun while the stun itself still applies. Riot's text says only 'invulnerable' and the kit carries no unstoppable or spell-shield flag, so I would not assert either way; the current whys[4] and wants.foe[1] wording ('blanks your E-wall combo') is left untouched.
